messages:
nora_support: Escalating thread — Pilot account 'StreamlineX' failing bulk dataset ingest during onboarding. Ingest jobs return 429 intermittently, many records marked DROPPED. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/112233. Customer says trial expires in 6 days and this blocks evaluation. :frowning:

diego_cs: Oof. Renewal signal already weak from last week's engagement. Need immediate comms plan and priority handling. Who can triage ingestion throughput?

ryan_ingest: I'll take a look. Initial glance at logs shows repeated backpressure from the batching service: "batch_queue_full" and downstream rate limiter spiking.

megan_se: Customer uploads are ~1.2M rows split across 6 files, each ~80MB. They used our SDK with default parallelism. We recommend chunking but pilot docs didn't call that out.

nora_support: They tried 3x retries client-side, still ~30% of records failed. Customer worried data loss. They're asking for a mitigation and an ETA for full integrity.

ryan_ingest: Short-term: I'll bump per-tenant ingest concurrency and temporarily increase the burst budget for StreamlineX. That should clear backlog in ~20-30m. Need Ops sign-off for quota change.

tara_ops: Approve temporary quota bump for tenant=streamlinex. I'll create an ops ticket and attach rollback conditions. Reminder: this touches rate-limiter config in prod.

deploy_bot: Ops ticket #OPS-770 created by tara_ops: change=tenant_burst_increase, safety_window=2h, rollback_on_error=true.

diego_cs: I'll message the customer: propose a 30-60m window to re-run the ingest with our assistance, confirm no data lost, and offer extension of trial by 7 days given the outage. Thoughts?

megan_se: Offer sounds right. Also offer an assisted ingest run with our SE on call to supervise and validate. We can script a dedupe/passive-verify to compare counts.

nora_support: I'll schedule assisted ingest with the customer for 45m from now and share a temporary upload token. Also attaching sample logs: ```ERROR ingest: record_id=abc123 dropped reason=batch_queue_full attempts=3```

ryan_ingest: Bumped concurrency and applied burst for streamlinex-prod; observing backlog drain. Monitoring shows drop rate decreasing from 28% -> 2% within 10 minutes.

tara_ops: Noted. Keeping change flagged for 2h then revert unless SE asks to keep. Runbook entry: https://runbook.redwood.ai/ingest/tenant-burst.

diego_cs: Customer reply: "Thanks — we'll try re-upload now. Demo team needs stable dataset for Friday." They asked for written comms and a post-mortem. I'll draft both.

megan_se: For permanent fix: propose SDK changes to chunk large files automatically and add client-side backoff + server-side queuing improvements. Estimate 3 sprints (6 weeks) for full rollout including migration plan. We can prioritize pilot-critical path: auto-chunk + clearer onboarding docs in 1 sprint (2 weeks).

nora_support: Customer completed assisted ingest; they report all records present. They appreciated extension offer and accepted +7 days trial extension.

diego_cs: Good. I'll send coordinated message: summary of immediate actions, the temporary fix, next steps (1-week onboarding doc + 6-week engineering plan), and the renewal extension. Will include exec sponsor note.

ryan_ingest: I'll open an internal ticket to investigate root cause: why queue filled — hypothesis: memory pressure on batcher node + sudden parallel uploads from SDK defaults. Tagging @megan_se for SDK changes.

deploy_bot: Internal ticket created: ENG-INGEST-991. Assignees=[ryan_ingest, megan_se]. Priority=high.

tara_ops: Recommend we also add per-tenant ingest size alerts to catch this earlier. I'll add to monitoring backlog.

megan_se: Acknowledged. I'll scope the SDK auto-chunk work and docs update; putting initial PR on my board for next sprint, target ETA 2 weeks for docs + sample script.

nora_support: Customer follow-up: "Appreciate the quick help, this was critical for demo. We'll re-evaluate renewal after pilot completes." They sounded neutral but open. I'll mark as Warm and keep close contact.

diego_cs: Action owners recap: nora_support 1	customer comms + follow-up, ryan_ingest 1	apply/review ingest throttle fix + RCA, megan_se 1	SDK auto-chunk + onboarding docs, tara_ops 1	ops ticket + monitoring. Keeping thread open until ENG-INGEST-991 has root cause and SDK PR is scheduled. :white_check_mark:
